headline: Binance's withdrawal restart day has arrived with no time announced, as the FBI names North Korea as the hacker.

market.asOf: Read from CoinGecko at about 03:57-03:58 UTC Sun 1 Nov (10:58 Bangkok). CoinMarketCap at the same time showed BTC near $77,150 and down about 1.75% over 24h, so the two sites disagree on the 24h direction. Use the live prices at the top of the page.
market.fearGreed: 30, Fear (alternative.me Crypto Fear & Greed Index). CoinMarketCap's own index read 35 out of 100.

stories.title: Binance withdrawal day is here, still with no time given
stories.summary: Binance says it has replaced 90% of the crypto taken in the hack and plans to reopen withdrawals in stages on Sunday 1 Nov. No hour has been announced, and no report we opened by about 04:00 UTC said withdrawals were back. The full Proof of Reserves (a public check that customer balances are fully backed) is expected by 3 Nov.
points: Binance says it has replenished 90% of the stolen crypto, up from about 80%, and remains on track to reopen withdrawals on Sunday 1 Nov, per CoinDesk.
Binance says it has reserved over $6.34B of company funds to cover the incident; security firm CertiK says it needs more information to verify the replacement holdings, per Forexcrunch.
Binance confirmed moving 7,499 BTC, about $581M, out of SAFU, its user-protection fund, and plans to rebuild SAFU to about $1B, per The Defiant.
Reopening is planned in stages, per CoinCentral.
Proof of Reserves date: CoinDesk says expected by 3 Nov; an earlier crypto.news report said by Monday 2 Nov.

stories.title: FBI says North Korea's hackers took the Binance funds; laundering hits a snag
stories.summary: The FBI says North Korea's TraderTraitor group carried out the theft and asked crypto firms to block hundreds of linked addresses. The stolen money keeps moving out in small pieces, but THORChain, a swap network the launderers used, paused most swaps after a glitch, which slowed them down.
points: The FBI named North Korea's TraderTraitor group and asked firms to block more than 600 ETH addresses, just under 20 BTC addresses and 1 SOL address, per CoinDesk.
Total stolen: Elliptic says about $6.43B across 11 blockchains; TRM Labs says $6.36B; the FBI says over $6 billion, per CoinDesk.
Frozen so far: Elliptic has verified $2.84B; CoinDesk says stablecoin issuers froze more than $2.4B.

THORChain halted swaps across most of its bridges after a rewrite of recent Ethereum blocks (a reorg) made it refund a 10 ETH deposit twice; Chainalysis said the pause delayed the laundering, per TokenPost.
Elliptic says about $93.5M has left the main Tron wallet and about $25M has gone into THORChain.

sources.label: TRM Labs: North Korea and Binance

stories.title: A red October ends, with US midterms on Tuesday
stories.summary: Big funds pulled money out of bitcoin and ether ETFs as the hack hit, and bitcoin finished October lower. On Tuesday 3 Nov the US votes in midterm elections that decide who in the next Congress takes up the stalled CLARITY Act on crypto market rules.
points: US spot bitcoin ETFs had $643.2M of net outflows on 30 Oct, led by BlackRock's IBIT at $233.7M; ether funds lost $155.7M that day and about $1.61B over October, per crypto.news.
October's final number differs by source: FinanceFeeds had bitcoin down about 7.4% from about $83,555 on Saturday afternoon, before the close; cryptonews.net says down 11.37%, measured from $87,220.
Crypto-linked groups spent about $176M across more than 100 midterm races, citing Reuters; Fairshake and its affiliates account for about $150.8M, per crypto.news.
The CLARITY Act's Senate vote to start debate failed 49-50 on 15 Sep, per crypto.news.

briefs.title: Ten big coins fully covered
briefs.summary: Binance says reserves in 10 major coins including BTC, ETH and BNB are fully covered; the rest, smaller tokens, is being bought on the market and over the counter.

briefs.title: How the reserves check works
briefs.summary: The new Proof of Reserves snapshot was taken at 00:00 UTC on 31 Oct; the proof takes 40-50 hours to generate, per Business Today.

briefs.title: Thousands of laundering addresses
briefs.summary: Chainalysis CEO Jonathan Levin says the attackers have used thousands of addresses and expects tens of thousands in the coming weeks, per CoinDesk.

briefs.title: Tron outflows tallied
briefs.summary: TRM Labs says Tron outflows from the hack total 612.7M USDT and 46.4M TRX, about $628M, and that Tether froze 378.7M USDT in two attacker wallets on Tron.

briefs.title: ETF outflows on one day
briefs.summary: Combined bitcoin and ether ETF outflows on 30 Oct were $799M, with BlackRock's ETHA about $76.6M of the ether side, per TokenPost.

briefs.title: Bitcoin options expiry next Friday
briefs.summary: Sources differ on the size of Friday's bitcoin options expiry: TokenPost says about $2.065B with a put/call ratio of 0.32; BigGo says $1.29B.

breaking.title: Binance to start first withdrawal phase after covering 95% of hack losses
breaking.summary: Binance says it has covered 95% of the $6.3B stolen in the hack, and the first phase of withdrawals, covering 15 assets including bitcoin, ether, XRP and dogecoin, will begin between 06:00 and 09:00 GMT on Sunday. The remaining 5% is less liquid tokens, and later phases have no date yet.
